2. Enter no.such.user.pwtest@mailinator.com and password WrongPassword#123
3. Click Log in
Expected results: The user stays on the login page and an error message is shown

Title: Valid login opens the Portal Gateway
Description: Verify a successful login leads to the portal selection
Test steps:
1. Open the login page
2. Enter the email and password of an existing account
3. Click Log in
Expected results: The 'Portal Gateway' page opens with the text 'Select your destination portal to proceed to your account.'
Notes: Playwright: login.spec.ts. Uses TEST_LOGIN_EMAIL and TEST_LOGIN_PASSWORD from .env. Skipped when they are not set. Signs in once on the live system

Title: Portal Gateway lists the three portals
Test steps:
1. Log in with an existing account
2. Look at the Portal Gateway
Expected results: Three choices are shown: Applicant Portal (Browse job openings, apply, and track status), Admin / Staff Portal (Manage system, job applications & recruitment) and HRMPSB Board Portal (Merit selection deliberations & candidate evaluations). The footer shows 'Zamboanga City Medical Center © 2026'

2. Click 'Back to login'
Notes: Playwright: login.spec.ts. To confirm whether the session is also ended

Expected results: The applicant side opens where the user can browse job openings and track applications
